messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the PM-112 postmortem — several remediation items are now overdue. Can owners confirm status?
jon: Which items specifically? I thought we closed the DB replica rollback playbook update.
sam: That one was done, but the deploy-safety gating (action 3) is still pending review. I pinged @olivia last week.
olivia: Sorry, got pulled into a priority outage. I can finish the gating PR by EOD tomorrow.
maria: Thanks @olivia. Action list from the doc: 1) Update rollback playbook - jon (done), 2) Deploy gating + test harness - olivia (overdue), 3) Add canary alert to pager - sam (blocked), 4) Run recurring incident analysis - unassigned.
jon: For 3) I put a draft alert query — needs sample traffic validation. Sam, do you need infra help to replay traffic?
sam: Yes, I don't have perms for the replay cluster. @maria can you or ops grant temporary access or run the replay?
incident-bot: Reminder: Action items due for PM-112: deploy gating (olivia) was due 2024-07-18. Escalation scheduled in 48h.
maria: I can run the replay for you today. Send me the tar of traces or the query you want replayed.
sam: Pushing a small harness to the replay bucket now: s3://redwood-replay/pm-112/harness-v2.tar.gz
olivia: Thanks, sam. I'll pick this up after lunch and open the PR. ETA tomorrow EOD. :thumbsup:
jon: Also proposing we assign the recurring incident analysis to someone—there were three incidents with the same error pattern over the last 30 days. If unassigned, this will never get traction.
maria: Agreed. @jon can you take the analysis? Estimated effort: 3-4 hours to aggregate logs and run the pattern scan.
jon: I can take it, will start today and post findings in the postmortem thread.
maria: Great — owners and deadlines now: olivia -> deploy gating PR (tomorrow EOD), sam -> add canary alert (blocked by replay, maria runs replay today), jon -> recurring incident analysis (today). I'll check back Friday for closure verification. If any item slips again, I'll escalate to Eng Directors.
olivia: Noted. If I hit blockers I'll ping here immediately.
jon: Small snippet to validate the replay locally if helpful:
```bash
# run on replay node
python tools/replay.py --input s3://redwood-replay/pm-112/harness-v2.tar.gz --target staging --rate 100
```
sam: Thanks, will coordinate with maria on creds.
incident-bot: Escalation alert queued: unresolved action items for PM-112 in 24h.
maria: Closing loop — once each item is marked done in the doc, reply with "done" here so I can verify and archive. :eyes:
